annotations.title: Try a look from a photo

description: Prepare a try-on: BeautySpark recreates a makeup look on the user's selfie. Give one reference: articleLookId (from find_article_looks) or savedLookId (from search_my_looks). Photos (a reference photo or a different selfie) can only be uploaded in the try-on widget, never taken from chat attachments. The saved selfie is used unless the user uploads another in the widget. Returns the credit cost and balance without charging; nothing is generated until confirm_look_generation.

articleLookId.description: A look id from find_article_looks, to try that article look on.

referencePhoto.description: Set by the try-on widget in ChatGPT. Leave unset.

referenceUploadId.description: Set by the try-on widget after an upload. Leave unset.

savedLookId.description: A saved look id from search_my_looks, to try one of the user's own looks on.

selfiePhoto.description: Set by the try-on widget in ChatGPT. Leave unset.

selfieUploadId.description: Set by the try-on widget after an upload. Leave unset.

name: try_look_from_photo
title: Try a look from a photo
